name: somi
description: A workflow plugin for coding agents: say what you want or pass a ticket, and it routes the work to the right workflow, on workers on the cheapest model that can do it.

commands.name: a11y-check
commands.description: Build or fix interface against an accessibility checklist and checker.

commands.name: code
commands.description: Build one clear change, with a review only if the diff calls for it.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Fix a bug whose cause is unknown, starting from a failing test.

commands.name: design
commands.description: Settle an expensive-to-reverse choice, with options and reversal costs.

commands.name: incident
commands.description: Restore a broken production service first, then record the follow-up.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Split large work into milestones that each get fresh context.

commands.name: refactor
commands.description: Change structure and keep behaviour, under green tests.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review the current changes or a named diff once.

commands.name: security-review
commands.description: Review for security on the strong tier, tracing input to each sink.

commands.name: ship
commands.description: Run the full suite, then write the pull request text.

commands.name: somi-config
commands.description: Show which model each tier uses in this environment.

commands.name: somi
commands.description: Give SoMi any request or ticket, and it routes the work to the right workflow.

commands.name: upgrade
commands.description: Upgrade a dependency from its real changelog and migrate its uses.
